text: I have disabled the CI test job for now. It has been red for two weeks because of the flaky integration tests and people are merging around it. Until someone owns the suite, CI is effectively running no tests again.

Rolled incremental indexing back in production. Update storms during bulk imports pushed indexing lag past 40 minutes. Until the mapping is reworked again the index still cannot take incremental updates at our volume, so the nightly rebuild stays.
Priya on invoices, Sofia on onboarding, Marcus on the k8s upgrade. Lena out until Monday.
Two platform offers accepted, starting in March. Data engineer loop continues.
After the enterprise deal, sharding by tenant is back on the Q4 roadmap. Treat it as planned again.
Reporting v2 is live. Thanks everyone. Watch the dashboards tonight.
Ada's last day was yesterday. Platform decisions she owned need new owners; Kwame is collecting the list.
Retro themes: too many Slack decisions never reach an ADR; nobody knows which rules are still real.
The July LaunchDarkly invoice came in at $2,100 after the seat true-up. That is four times what we budgeted.
Zero pages this week. Shadowing is going well.
Renegotiated LaunchDarkly to a startup plan at $450 a month for 12 months. Under budget again, for now.
Invoice generation is 3x faster after the query rewrite.
Q4 priorities: enterprise SSO rollout, reporting exports, mobile refresh.
